text: {"lessons":["A few months of small gains and losses do not show whether I am beating the market; I should judge decisions over a longer horizon against a benchmark.","Selling at a loss or a gain is not a strategy by itself; I should reassess each holding using its outlook rather than my average cost or recent price moves.","Frequent shifts between stocks can add risk without clear benefit; I should size positions carefully and keep enough cash to preserve flexibility."]}
